subject: POC addendum — include chat & multi-search flows; updated eval plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kahn <samir@shopgrid.ai>, Lina Ortiz <lina@shopgrid.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC addendum — include chat & multi-search flows; updated eval plan

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning, Samir and Lina — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same plan. I captured the bits we agreed to on the call and a suggested narrow path to keep the trial focused while letting us validate the broader set of asks.

Key notes from call:
- Primary goal: validate if Redwood inference can serve ShopGrid search and a lightweight conversational layer with consistent latency and quality (1-week functional smoke + 2-week performance run).
- New ask: add two extra flows to trial mid-run — (A) multi-field product search (title + specs + Q&A signals) and (B) short conversational guidance for product discovery (chat).
- Constraints: you want to keep initial success criteria strict for core search, but also see qualitative signals on chat.

Proposed rebaseline (short):
1) Timeline: start trial on Mon 2026-07-20. Week 1: ingest sample index + smoke tests. Weeks 2–3: performance and quality run. Mid-run scope add on Day 10 if smoke tests are green.
2) Success criteria (core search):
   - p95 inference latency (99% trimmed) < 220ms for 512-token budget under test harness load
   - Top-1 relevance lift >= 8% vs baseline (sample queries in attached CSV)
   - No more than 0.5% requests failing with server errors
3) Chat evaluation (qualitative + quant):
   - Handful (n=50) of representative chat sessions reviewed for hallucination rate < 8% and correct intent routing to product pages >= 85%
4) Ownership:
   - Redwood: Rishi (trial lead) — runtime configs, sampling harness, observability dashboards
   - ShopGrid: Samir (product) and Lina (data) — provide sample index/export, evaluation labels, and access to test environment

Attachments: POC-success-metrics-v1.xlsx (scoring sheet), shopgrid-eval-sample-queries.csv

Next steps (action items):
- Samir/Lina: confirm you can start on Mon 7/20 and provide the sample export by 7/17 EOD.
- Rishi: build and share the smoke test script and dashboard by 7/18.
- Monica: run coordination call on 7/19 to unblock infra.

If you want, I can flip the schedule to start smoke tests earlier — call this a working plan.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

--
Attachment(s): POC-success-metrics-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB), shopgrid-eval-sample-queries.csv (csv, 4KB)

Subject: Re: POC addendum — include chat & multi-search flows; updated eval plan

Thanks Monica — this is great and matches what we discussed. A couple of clarifications and one request to broaden the scope mid-run:

Clarifications:
- We can definitely get the export to you by 7/17, Lina will own that.
- The latency target looks reasonable; we may ask for a lower p95 if the baseline is much better after week 1.

Scope add request (mid-trial):
- If week 1 smoke tests pass, we'd like to add an "intent-aware autocomplete" flow into the trial on Day 10. This is a lighter-weight feature than full chat but important for our UX team to validate.
- For the autocomplete flow, success is judged on reduction in zero-result queries and increase in click-through on suggested query completions (we'll supply a baseline).

We're fine with the owners as listed. Please add a short evaluation checklist for the autocomplete flow so Lina's team can prepare labels in advance.

Samir
VP Product, ShopGrid
samir@shopgrid.ai | +1 (617) 555-0910

Thanks Samir — happy to add the autocomplete checklist. Draft below and attached a small sample harness. If everyone is good, I will push the updated harness and schedule a 30-min sync for Thurs 7/16 to walk through the test inputs.

Autocomplete evaluation checklist (draft):
- Dataset: 1,000 historical queries + 200 curated edge cases from ShopGrid (Lina to provide)
- Metrics collected: reduction in zero-result queries (%), suggestion CTR (click-through-rate), suggestion relevance (human-rated 1-5 on 200 samples)
- Pass threshold: 15% reduction in zero-results OR suggestion CTR >= 12% with average relevance >= 3.5/5
- Latency: median completion suggestion time < 80ms under harness

I also attached a lightweight harness (rebaseline-notes-20260715.pdf) that shows the combined schedule and checklists across flows.

Action items updated:
- Lina: please upload sample edge-cases and the export by 7/17 EOD.
- Monica: confirm 7/19 coordination call (30m).
- Rishi: ship harness and dashboards by 7/18, schedule 7/16 sync for inputs review.
